build.reason: The C++ entry passes an undeclared jobj to the foreach macro and two arguments to a function declared with one.

input.reason: For finite short JSON inputs such as {}, the entry passes the fuzzer bytes and length to the parser, which accepts an empty object.

lifecycle.reason: On the ordinary allocation path, the entry releases both its parsed object and tokener; object release accepts null parse results.

control_flow.reason: The target cannot execute its parse-to-serialization route because its translation unit does not compile.

accepted.requirement: Pass a declared parsed-object variable to json_object_object_foreach.
accepted.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput parses into obj, then unconditionally expands json_object_object_foreach(jobj, key, val).
accepted.failure_condition: jobj has no declaration in the complete target translation unit; either supplied macro form uses that argument as an expression during C++ compilation.
accepted.alternative_paths: No input can bypass compilation of the unconditional macro invocation.

source_evidence.quote:
#define json_object_object_foreach(obj, key, val)                                \
	char *key = NULL;                                                        \
	struct json_object *val __attribute__((__unused__)) = NULL;              \
	for (struct lh_entry *entry##key = lh_table_head(json_object_get_object(obj)),    \
	                     *entry_next##key = NULL;                            \
	     ({                                                                  \
		     if (entry##key)                                             \
		     {                                                           \
			     key = (char *)lh_entry_k(entry##key);               \
			     val = (struct json_object *)lh_entry_v(entry##key); \
			     entry_next##key = lh_entry_next(entry##key);        \
		     };                                                          \
		     entry##key;                                                 \
	     });                                                                 \
	     entry##key = entry_next##key)

#define json_object_object_foreach(obj, key, val)                              \
	char *key = NULL;                                                      \
	struct json_object *val = NULL;                                        \
	struct lh_entry *entry##key;                                           \
	struct lh_entry *entry_next##key = NULL;                               \
	for (entry##key = lh_table_head(json_object_get_object(obj));          \
	     (entry##key ? (key = (char *)lh_entry_k(entry##key),              \
	                   val = (struct json_object *)lh_entry_v(entry##key), \
	                   entry_next##key = lh_entry_next(entry##key), entry##key)     \
	                 : 0);                                                 \
	     entry##key = entry_next##key)

accepted.failure_condition: The declared json_object_to_json_string takes one argument, while the C++ target supplies two.
accepted.alternative_paths: No input can bypass compilation of this unconditional call.
